subject.title: auth.order ignored for GitHub Copilot provider — first profile in auth.profiles always wins

question: Should maintainers adopt, refresh, replace, or close the open fork PR that claims to fix this GitHub Copilot `auth.order` bug?
rationale: The bug is still present on current main, but a linked open fork PR already claims the fix and is currently conflicting, so automation should not queue a duplicate repair until maintainers choose the landing path.

options.title: Replace or adopt the fork PR
options.body: Use the fork PR as source context, then land a narrow same-repo fix if that branch cannot be refreshed cleanly.

options.title: Ask for a refresh
options.body: Keep the fork PR as the candidate and ask the contributor to rebase and provide current proof.

options.title: Close the fork PR first
options.body: Close the fork PR as no longer viable before allowing a fresh repair lane for this issue.

recommendation.title: Replace or adopt the fork PR
recommendation.body: Use the fork PR as source context, then land a narrow same-repo fix if that branch cannot be refreshed cleanly.
